metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-11. - Legislative intent.
content.summary:
It is the intent of the city to require the control of snow, ice, or slush nuisances
               to the fullest extent possible.
(
Ord. No. 4098, § 2, 11-19-2007
)
